title: What Is AI
style: Indie-pop with a mid-tempo bounce, syncopated handclaps, skittering percussion, and warm synth bass; verse stays sparse with dry close-mic vocal and little rhythmic taps, pre-chorus opens into stacked harmonies and rising filtered pads, chorus lands on a short chanty hook with doubled lead and gang responses. Add reversed swells into each chorus, tiny blips between lines, and a bright punchy mix with intimate vocal upfront.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
ai? what? what is ai.
no really what does it do.
What does it really stand for
arti telli facil tech no knowlegablity
or artificial tech
or artificial intelligence.

[Pre-Chorus]
hmm more like algorithm tech following,
surfing the same old wave.
we need something we new.
like something we knew.

[Chorus]
what is ai
what is ai
we need something we new
it does not forget (does not forget)

what is ai
what is ai
with no regret
a spark that lasts

[Verse 2]
it does not forget.
with no regret.
a spark that lasts.
we could have a blast!

[Chorus]
what is ai
what is ai
we need something we new
it does not forget (does not forget)

what is ai
what is ai
with no regret
a spark that lasts

[Outro]
we could have a blast!
we could have a blast!
